comments.text: I'm a mental health counselor at a hospital and I don't work in administration. It would improve patient care and employee work/life balance if nurses and other healthcare professionals were not allowed to work more than 40 hours a week unless there is a critical staffing need. Hospitals would have to create more full-time positions to staff their facilities, wages would increase with demand, and healthcare professionals would be more rested and provide better patient care. PRN staff should fill routine additional shifts. I know a lot of nurses feel dependent on overtime but when facilities are used to routinely providing overtime rather than creating more full-time positions with benefits it is detrimental to employees and patients.
